provenance.prompt: Purpose: original static vanity tables for the existing company room/floor installation and tabletop support chain. Each table stays within 1.10m width x 0.78m height x 0.50m depth, in metres, +Y up, +Z toward the user, origin at bottom centre. The real top board is 0.035m thick, with top at Y=0.78. Preserve the fixed support patch, knee clearance and front operation area from the functional contract. Use closed convex solid parts connected to the top/ground support network. Keep all structure out of the knee prism. Build four true structural designs with bounded editable frame width, solid materials, no textures, no animations and at most 2500 triangles, 32 meshes and four materials. Export deterministic self-contained GLB using pinned Three.js 0.187.0 and read the actual file back through GLTFLoader, support geometry and vanity solid checks. Design: Rectangular top supported by four legs with four solid metal caster bridges, twin fork plates and thick closed twelve-segment wheels with their axes along X. Fork plates intersect the actual wheel side volumes and bridges, and the lowest wheel edge is at ground Y=0.
provenance.method: Original bounded boxes and closed 12-segment cylinders. Final source bounds are baked into Float32 vertices, with identity nodes. Actual GLTFLoader readback passes shared support and independent vanity solid/connection/knee checks.
limitations: Static caster appearance. Repositioning uses the existing facility transform. No physical rolling, steering, braking or simulation state.
